patent.title: 盘壳
assignees: 美卓人造板机械（瑞典）公司
patent.family_note: Holdout E4-N2. Grant assignee Metso Panelboard AB; litigant 维美德公司 (Valmet succession). PCT/SE2006/000413. Single-patent Nanjing judgment (2020)苏01民初1204号.

knowledge_origin.description: Foreign industrial OEM inventorship/assignment chain not fully reconstructed beyond grant assignee and Valmet plaintiff standing in judgment.

technology.problem: 磨浆机盘壳内纤维物料导出与气流/沟槽几何控制。
technology.mechanism: 气密包围对转磨盘的盘壳；周缘半径连续增大的沟槽延续至切向出口；出口处可调泄放阀开口（claim 1 要素，裁判比对）。

value_carriers.name: 镇江中福马被诉热磨机盘壳（BM 系列等）
value_carriers.description: Court element match of accused disc housing to claim 1. Accused machines are thermomechanical pulp systems; patent claims the disc housing subcomponent.

value_metrics.metric_name: court-awarded patent infringement damages and costs
value_metrics.note: Based on infringer profits (≥30 units × discretionary ¥2M profit), NOT proven plaintiff sales-loss. Dispute-specific E4.

gaps.description: Award uses discretionary per-unit infringer profit on systems that include more than the patented disc housing; plaintiff named sales contracts were held insufficient for actual-loss proof.
No separate field-normalized quality score beyond infringement.

notes: Holdout E4-N2. T0=2026-10-13. Single-ZL court E3+E4+E5 → R5. Corrects nomination soft label: court used infringer profits, not plaintiff sales-loss. Judgment≠intrinsic price.
